entities.name: Nethroi
entities.description: Apex monster of the Indatha triome on Ikoria, a cat-nightmare-beast hybrid with the power to raise the dead.

entities.name: Indatha
entities.description: Triome of Ikoria where Nethroi dwells.

events.summary: Nethroi's dominion over death lets it consume both flesh and soul; sages hold being eaten by it erases one from existence.
events.quote: There is an ancient tale of Nethroi's first kill.

relations.quote: is the apex monster of the Indatha triome on Ikoria
